description: This file defines a PHP class 'VersionAPI' which extends an abstract REST controller and provides an API endpoint for retrieving available version migration identifiers, optionally excluding the latest version.

classes.name: VersionAPI
classes.description: A REST API controller class that returns a list of version identifiers, with optional exclusion of the latest version.

methods.name: handleGet
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve the list of migration versions, optionally excluding the latest version based on request parameter.
